_about: My scrutiny of the 161 concepts the study flagged as skip. Keys are the concepts' exact names. Verdict 'have' = Paddock has the capability another way already; 'adapt' = worth having, through an integration or a small build, with the how. Every skipped concept not listed here keeps the verdict 'plumbing': an Oracle-database mechanism whose job the framework, Clerk or the browser already does.
Feature Page Types: Login and Access Control are Clerk; Feedback is /feedback; Theme Style Selection is the theme picker; the About page exists; Activity Reporting is the Data workspace; Configuration Options is the Build Options editor.
Global Page: The shell: header, footer and phone bar are shared components drawn on every page.
Login Page (Feature Page type): Clerk's sign-in and sign-up pages; a Clerk widget component places them.
Page Groups: Six page groups exist and the Page Finder filters by them.
Authentication (Verifying User Identity): Clerk; the Security tab shows it read-only.
Build Option (feature toggle): The Build Options editor exists and two features honour it; a build option per region comes in Phase 1.
Text Message: Text Messages exist (six chrome strings, more as needed).
Shortcut: Shortcuts exist and substitute into Static Content.
Static Application Files: Assets on R2 through the Assets editor.
PWA: General & Installability: Manifest and install prompt exist; an Application Definition PWA tab later shows them.
PWA: Shortcuts & Push Notifications: Web push with VAPID keys is live; settings under /settings/notifications.
Application Definition - Availability: The maintenance notice in Application Definition.
Component Settings (concept): Component Settings exist (caption, list style, button label); every new component adds its defaults.
Region Grid Layout (Start New Row, Colum: Exactly this grid, with a Size quick pick.
Navigation Menu: The navigation lists render the menu, the bar and the footer.
Static List Entry: List entries with label, destination and authorization; icon, badge, condition and nesting to add.
Comment Out / Uncomment (page components: A region hidden at first, or a build option, does the same job.
Search Configuration (Shared Component): The site's own search index with search hints.
Map (region type): Leaflet with OpenStreetMap tiles; the Map component wraps it in Phase 2.
Map Layer: Circuits with coordinates in content; GeoJSON where needed.
Calendar (region type): The Calendar component shipped in R4.1; no drag and drop wanted.
Calendar Drag and Drop: Not wanted: sessions come from the feeds, nobody drags them.
Calendar Initialization JavaScript Code: The calendar's settings are declared, not scripted.
Chart Custom JavaScript (JET options): Recharts draws the charts; the Chart component exposes settings, not code.
Switch Theme Wizard: The theme picker switches among the shipped and custom themes.
Lost Update Detection: Every save carries the base revision; a moved base is refused with 409.
REST Data Source: The loader fetches upstreams from a clean IP and writes snapshots and tables; the Worker reads rows.
REST Data Source Credential: Secrets live in the Worker's environment, named in the code, never in rows.
REST Data Source Operations vs Legacy We: One writer, many readers; no generic CRUD binding needed.
JSON Source: Content sidecars under content/series/<slug>/ are the JSON sources.
JSON Source data constraints: Supabase JSONB where a document is stored.
Authorization Scheme Types: Public, signed in, contributor, administrator; group membership is the Clerk role.
Attaching an Authorization Scheme: Attached to pages, regions and list entries; buttons and columns follow their components.
Application Definition - Properties: Name, wordmark, date chip and install prompt are there; compatibility mode and Oracle Text do not apply.
Source Location and Source Type: Phase 2's source catalogue: series, season, table, count picked from a list; the 4.3 Object Browser becomes the picker.
Email Template: Resend is already the sender (lib/email.ts: the contact form, the welcome email, the feedback board, the draft-ready alert). Add an Email Templates shared component: subject and body with placeholders, edited in the designer, one small PR.
Automation: GitHub Actions runs the loader every 20 minutes and the crons; add an Automations page in Data listing workflows and crons with last run, next run and a Run now button (the dispatch call exists). One small PR.
Automation Scheduling mechanics: Cloudflare cron triggers could replace external crons for revalidation; the loader stays on GitHub Actions for its clean IP.
Automation Import/Export behavior: Workflows are in the repo; nothing to import.
Interactive Report / Interactive Grid -: The Table component gets Users may sort, filter and download CSV as settings, through TanStack Table (a small MIT library, no vendor). Saved views later if wanted.
Editable Interactive Grid: Editing stays a Form per row; inline spreadsheet editing is not wanted for a reading site.
Interactive Report toolbar and menus (Co: Sort and download through the Table settings; a scheduled email digest later through Resend if wanted.
Updatable Column and Column as List of V: Not for readers; the studio's table edits through forms.
Debug Mode (runtime toolbar): A Debug panel in the preview's developer toolbar: which source each component read, which loader run it came from, how long it took, which show and authorization rules fired. Small, in the Quick Edit PR.
Debugging Dynamic Actions: The same Debug panel lists the dynamic actions that fired.
Workflow Diagram (region type): No engine and no diagram; a Tasks list over the approvals Paddock already has (author requests, thread moderation, post review, feedback) is the shape of the Members and Moderation pages.
Page Process Types (integration/notifica: Email through Resend and push through web-push exist as code paths; a Form's success step will be able to send either. AI stays out of the designer by your rule.
Cancel Dialog / Close Dialog (dialog pag: Page modes (modal dialog, drawer) in Phase 4; the contact modal already exists in code.
Copy Page Wizard: Copy Page in Phase 4, one small PR.
URL (region type, detail): The Embed component: a video or an allowed iframe, Phase 2.
Globalization Attributes: Later, only if a second language is wanted: Text Messages already hold the strings; a translation library would add the catalogue. Venue-local dates already follow your rule.
Report Template: Column/Row Templates (c: A row highlight rule in the Table component (leader, podium, the reader's followed series) as a setting.
Application Definition - Workflow, Print: Copyright is a text message today; PDF printing later through Cloudflare Browser Rendering if ever wanted; file storage is R2.
Actions: Execute, Style & Notification: Show, hide, add class, alert and confirm come with the Form work; server-side code stays out; AI stays out by your rule.
Tree (region type): No hierarchy pages today; the Learn hub's topics could use a Tree later.
